posting.description:
• Department: Sales
  • Reports to: Chief Sales Officer
  • Location: Remote

Make a greater impact at Bonduelle Americas!

Bonduelle Americas is a certified B Corp inviting people to embrace a flexitarian lifestyle with an expanding portfolio of plant-rich products available in and beyond the produce aisle. We operate four facilities and employ nearly 3,000 Associates in the US.

Bonduelle Americas is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Groupe Bonduelle (BON.PA), an established global brand with more than 170 years of family heritage bringing the joy of plants to tables around the world. Globally, our ready-to-eat plant-rich food products are grown on 173,000 acres by our grower partners and marketed in nearly 100 countries. Our mission is to inspire the transition toward a plant-rich diet to contribute to people's well-being and planet health.

Join us at Bonduelle Americas for an opportunity to advance your career in a culture that places people first. As a valued member of our company, you will work in a mission-driven environment aimed at preserving the planet’s resources while providing healthy plant-based products to millions of consumers around the world.

Position Summary:

The VP of Sales, Base Business Development leads Bonduelle Americas’ core retail sales organization, with accountability for several of the company’s largest and most strategically important national and regional grocery accounts, as well as the private label business. Reporting to the Chief Sales Officer, this role is responsible for protecting and growing the base business – the foundation of Bonduelle’s revenue and shelf presence – through disciplined account management, strong retailer relationships, and a well-run private label engine. The VP leads a team of seven: three National Account Directors covering Aldi, Wakefern, Ahold Delhaize, H-E-B, and Stater Bros; two Regional Account Managers covering a portfolio of regional grocery customers; and two Private Label Managers who own the RFP, innovation, and program management processes that support Bonduelle’s private label partnerships. This is a remote, field-facing leadership role requiring frequent travel to customers, industry events, and Bonduelle’s Philadelphia headquarters.

Key Responsibilities:

    National & Regional Account Leadership

    • Lead and develop a team of three National Account Directors (Aldi, Wakefern, Ahold Delhaize, H-E-B, Stater Bros) and two Regional Account Managers, setting clear account strategy, targets, and accountability.
    • Own the executive-level relationship with key national and regional retail customers, serving as Bonduelle’s senior sales point of contact alongside the account teams.
    • Set annual volume, distribution, and profitability targets for the base business portfolio and hold the team accountable to performance against plan.
    • Guide the development and negotiation of annual joint business plans (JBPs), pricing actions, and trade investment strategies across the account base.
    • Ensure DSMP compliance, secondary display execution, and promotional programming are consistently delivered across national and regional accounts.
    • Identify and pursue incremental distribution, new item placement, and category expansion opportunities within the existing account base.
    • Partner with the Director of Sales Operations and Customer Sales Planning team to ensure accounts are set up accurately and forecasts reflect current account activity.

    Private Label Leadership

    • Lead and develop a team of two Private Label Managers responsible for the end-to-end management of Bonduelle’s private label business.
    • Oversee the development of RFP responses and business cases, ensuring competitive, profitable proposals that reflect accurate costing, capacity, and margin requirements.
    • Lead private label contract and pricing negotiations, balancing volume and relationship value against margin and capacity constraints.
    • Partner with Product Development/R&D on innovation and formulation for private label and co-manufactured products, ensuring customer specifications and cost targets are met.
    • Oversee artwork and packaging development and approval for private label items, ensuring accuracy, regulatory compliance, and on-time execution against customer timelines.
    • Own private label product lifecycle management, including item setup, specification maintenance, and coordination of product samples to customers.
    • Partner with Supply Chain and Operations to ensure private label capacity planning, cost inputs, and service levels support the business case underlying each program.

    Cross-Functional & Strategic Leadership

    • Partner with the Chief Sales Officer to set base business and private label strategy, resource allocation, and priorities across the broader sales organization.
    • Represent the base business and private label portfolio in leadership forums, providing accurate forecasts, risk assessment, and growth opportunities.
    • Collaborate with Marketing, Category Strategy & Insights, and Revenue Growth Management to ensure account and private label strategies are grounded in strong data and category logic.
    • Coach and develop the broader team, building a strong bench and succession plan across both the branded account and private label functions.
    • Monitor competitive activity, retailer strategy shifts, and private label market trends, translating insight into proactive account and program strategy.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or related field; MBA a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive CPG sales experience, including direct national account management with major grocery retailers; fresh/perishable or produce category experience strongly preferred.
  • Private label experience required, including RFP/business case development, contract negotiation, and cross-functional program management.
  • 5+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Deep understanding of the grocery retail landscape, including experience with hard discount (Aldi), cooperative (Wakefern), and regional grocery models.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, with experience owning P&L-level account and program economics.
  • Excellent negotiation and executive presence, with the ability to represent Bonduelle credibly at the senior buyer and retailer leadership level.
  • Ability to travel frequently to support customer meetings, private label program milestones, and periodic time at Bonduelle’s Philadelphia headquarters.
  • The base business portfolio delivers consistent, profitable growth in volume, distribution, and shelf presence across national and regional accounts.
  • Private label programs are won and executed on time, with strong RFP win rates, clean artwork/packaging execution, and reliable product delivery.
  • National and regional account teams operate with clear strategy, strong retailer relationships, and disciplined execution against JBPs.
  • Private label and branded account strategies are well-coordinated with Supply Chain, R&D, and Marketing, avoiding surprises and capacity conflicts.
  • The Chief Sales Officer views this role as a trusted steward of Bonduelle’s core revenue base and a strong developer of sales talent.
posting.title: VP of Sales, Base Business Development

posting.description:
Join a tech company that’s making a difference in healthcare

At Sectra Canada, our objective is to introduce a leading global medical IT solution to the Canadian market, with the aim of establishing ourselves as the top provider of Enterprise imaging and PACS solutions in the country. Our customers operate in some of Canada’s most critical functions, and we are uniquely positioned to help them optimize patient-centered care. Our modular and scalable enterprise imaging solutions allow healthcare providers to grow from ology to ology, while providing efficiencies and advanced technology to modernize Canada’s medical imaging systems, all while protecting the most sensitive information for patients and care providers. 

The Role

Sectra is looking for a Cloud Engineer that will assist in maintaining, supporting, improving, and deploying the Sectra product suites in the Microsoft Azure cloud as a SaaS offering within our Sectra PACS. The position will report to the regional cloud operations manager.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will deploy and operate Sectra’s complete SaaS offering that is tightly integrated with Microsoft Azure native services. This includes:

  • Drive and support system reliability, scale and performance activities
  • Ensure the solution is kept up-to-date from OS-level up to application level (Sectra’s own products and 3rd party)
  • Assist with upgrading, installing, and configuring monitoring solutions for Windows and Linux servers
  • Operate resilience measures such as Backup/Restore routines, load-balancing and other means of scaling across the solution and per individual Virtual Machine
  • Develop solutions integrating Microsoft Azure commercial clouds with services hosted on-premises and in other clouds
  • Understand networking technologies
  • Escalate, own, and stay focused in driving the resolution of issues through the appropriate channels and team members, using highly effective communication skills
  • Develop and maintain software solutions/scripts to support automation of cloud operations, configuration, and administration
  • Create scripts to creating, auditing, and monitoring Azure resources
  • Develop new solutions that are future-proof towards both existing and future solutions
  • Support security audits, accreditation, and certification processes
  • Ensure that all cloud solutions follow both internal as well as external security and compliance controls applicable towards our business segments
  • Maintain and administer security measures such as vulnerability scanning, security logging and anti-malware and endpoint protection
  • Assess and maintain security configuration on application, solution and subscription level
  • Audit and apply Azure security best practices to all types of Azure resources
  • Maintain and administer identity access management (IAM)

How we make your work meaningful and rewarding

As the newest Sectra operation, Sectra Canada has the best of both worlds. We embody the energy of a young startup while enjoying the stability of a well-established brand, vast global experience, and a product backed by 40+ years of innovation. The result? An agile, invigorating, highly supportive and fun environment that empowers our team to do their best work and make a difference in people’s lives every day.

In addition to competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a slew of exciting benefits and perks, including:

  • Education assistance for team members to continuously enhance their knowledge
  • Robust health, dental and vision benefits, effective the month following your start date
  • Monthly health spending account
  • RRSP matching after 3 months
  • Reimbursement of home internet expense
  • Minimum 4 weeks of vacation

So, are you a fit?

We hire for attitude and ability, train for skill. Our people have the knowledge to meet expectations, but more importantly the passion to exceed them consistently. We’re all about learning from and challenging each other and going all in for every customer. To add to our amazing team, these attributes will be crucial to your success:

  • A drive to make things happen
  • A longing to make a difference in the healthcare industry
  • A hunger to learn and improve at every opportunity
  • A true team player eager to share your knowledge with the team

Think you’ve got what it takes? Great. Here's a few more boxes we’re also hoping you can tick:

  • Computer engineering degree or equivalent with strong academic performance.
  • Up to 5 years of technology field experience.
  • Up to 5 years of Azure and AWS cloud experience.
  • Experience working with PACS, RIS, DICOM, HL7, IHE and other healthcare interoperability standards
  • Capable of technical deep dives into infrastructure, databases, and applications, while also developing support and deployment strategies.
  • Passion for service excellence, with exceptional customer interaction and communication skills.
  • Highly organized and deadline-driven, and enjoy a fast-paced work setting
  • Ability travel (10% - 15%)
  • Also nice to have:
    • Experience working with IT service desk or customer service
    • Strong experience working with Windows, MS SQL Server, SQL Server AlwaysOn, networks, Active Directory, hardware, clustering, programming or scripting tools, and VMware
    • Meticulous about documentation
    • Ability to communicate in multiple languages (French would be a definite asset)

Our salary range for this role falls between $71,700 and $96,600. The final salary offer will depend on several key factors, including the candidate's level of experience, their specific skill set, and the overall alignment with the job requirements. Other considerations may include the candidate’s education, certifications, and any additional relevant qualifications. We aim to offer a competitive salary that reflects the value each individual brings to our team.

Equal opportunity employer

Healthcare is a universal priority, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a healthier and safer society. Our employees are people with different strengths, interests, experiences and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. We embrace our differences and celebrate our uniqueness, and we respect and value all of our employees' points of views. Our non-discrimination policy extends beyond recruitment practices to encompass all terms, conditions and privileges of employment as well as the use of all company facilities, participation in all company-sponsored activities, and all employment actions such as promotions, compensation, benefits and termination of employment.

The goal is for the right candidate to start as soon as possible.

We recruit on an ongoing basis. This means we encourage you to apply or contact us as soon as possible.

Depending on the role, a mandatory background security screening might be performed as part of the recruitment process at Sectra. Please reach out to the responsible hiring team if you have any questions regarding this. Learn more about our recruitment process here.

posting.description:
Om tjänsten
Grillska Gymnasiet i Västerås söker nu en vikarierande gymnasielärare för undervisning i ekonomi- och juridikämnen under vårterminen 2027. Vikariatet kan komma att övergå till en tillsvidaretjänst

I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår att undervisa i ekonomi- och juridikkurser, men kan ändras beroende på kompetens och behörighet. Delat mentorskap för en klass ingår också . Du leder undervisningen i klassrummet och eleverna mot målen i kurserna. Du kommer att ingå i ekonomiarbetslaget och är ansvarig för att tillsammans med dina kollegor utveckla programmet.

Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som trivs att arbeta med ungdomar och drivs av att få dem att växa och utvecklas. Du kommer ingå i ett arbetslag med kunniga och engagerade kollegor, som samarbetar för att skapa en trygg och utvecklande miljö. Öppenheten mellan lärare är stor och vi tar ett gemensamt ansvar för att alla elever ska lyckas. Som person har du ett stort driv och en god förmåga att engagera och entusiasmera elever i din undervisning. I ditt arbetssätt är du strukturerad, tydlig och har en god förmåga att prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter. Vi värdesätter din förmåga att möta eleverna utifrån deras kunskaper och behov samt förmåga att skapa goda relationer. För att trivas som lärare på Grillska Gymnasiet i Västerås behöver du se värdet i att samarbeta med kollegor och elever för att nå bästa möjliga resultat. Eleven är vår viktigaste resurs och vår målsättning är alltid att arbeta med deras utveckling i fokus.

Våra pedagogiska kännetecken

Alla lektioner är sammanhållna och långa, 120-180 minuter undervisningstid. Lektionerna följer en struktur med tydliga mål och syften och är varierande i arbetssätt.

Våra skolor arbetar med en stark värdegrund för samhällsförbättring och allas lika värde. Det är viktigt för oss att du delar vår värdegrund.

Kvalifikationer
Det är önskvärt att du är legitimerad lärare i ekonomi- och juridikämnena och med erfarenhet inom yrket. Stort vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet och mycket goda kunskaper inom ämnet och förmåga att lära ut.

Villkor Anställningsform: Vikariat under vårterminen 2027,

Löneform: Månadslön. Individuell lönesättning.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Observera att intervjuer för tjänsten kommer att ske löpande, tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Vi har gjort våra val av annonskanaler och vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.
posting.title: Vikarie  i ekonomi och juridikämnen på  Grillska Gymnasiet Västerås
